title: add vpc control plane: multi-account peering, route53 delegation, endpoints, sgs
author: Nina Patel
description: Motivation: enable multi-AZ, cross-account private control plane deployments for enterprise customers. This PR extends the control-plane Terraform modules and installer/Helm artifacts to support: 1) multi-account VPC peering (cross-account route tables + shared peering acceptor), 2) Route53 private hosted zone delegation for cross-account DNS resolution and conditional forwarding, 3) interface and gateway endpoint provisioning for SSM/ECR/S3 and optional VPC interface endpoints for private control plane traffic, 4) security group templates and least-privilege ingress rules for control-plane components, and 5) upgrade hooks and smoke checks to validate network reachability post-deploy. Changes are intentionally additive (new module inputs, separate "peering" resources and DNS delegation flow) and include migration docs and a rollback plan. See Linear ENG-7821 for background and design notes. Checklist: [x] Terraform module + tests, [x] Helm chart values + chart bump, [x] installer upgrade hook + smoke test, [x] KMS policy updates (docs), [x] docs/vpc-control-plane.md updates, [x] run terraform plan and apply on staging. Related: previous VPC PRs that added single-account control plane (see PRs in repo history).

release_notes: Add optional cross-account VPC peering for control plane (opt-in via module input 'enable_peering')
Support Route53 private hosted zone delegation and outbound resolver rules for cross-account DNS resolution
Provision recommended interface/gateway endpoints for private control plane traffic (SSM, ECR, S3)
New security group templates for control plane components with least-privilege defaults
Installer upgrade hook validates network reachability and DNS post-upgrade
